configureCampaignEscrow(address).notice: One-time deployment wiring for the campaign escrow. It is intentionally unavailable after locking and is not a review authority.

finalizeNoAppeal(bytes32).notice: Converts the latest completed review round into a payout- consumable result only after its permissionless appeal window expires.

finalizeProtocolFailure(bytes32).notice: Terminalizes a case that cannot form a valid court after its frozen enrollment or randomness deadline. This is permissionless and never creates a substantive PASS or FAIL.

openAppeal(bytes32,address).notice: Opens a fresh review round without reusing Judges from the root case. The Campaign contract remains the only case creator boundary; requester eligibility is checked by that contract before this call.

openRetry(bytes32).notice: Opens the next bounded review attempt after a no-quorum, randomness, invalid-court or tied-round failure. The previous case is settled as protocol failure before its Judge locks can be reused.
